title: Private deploy roadmap slice planning: prioritized feature slices and gating
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Quarterly roadmap planning ticket that defines the feature slices, acceptance gates and rollout sequencing for Private/VPC/On‑Prem enterprise capabilities. Goal is to produce a 90‑day execution plan broken into 3 delivery slices with clear ownership, measurable success metrics and an explicit security/compliance gating checklist to unblock sales and pilot customers.
objectives: Finalize prioritized feature slices for 90-day window (slice A/B/C) and publish a stakeholder-aligned timeline
Align features to OKRs: reduce private deploy lead time by 40%, achieve SOC2-ready audit checklist completion, and enable 3 pilot customers on VPC/On‑Prem flows
Define release gating criteria: upgrade/rollback plan, KMS/HSM signoff, SSO/SAML integration test matrix
success_metrics: Private deployment lead time (code->customer signoff) reduced from baseline to <= 14 days
Number of pilot customers successfully onboarded: target 3 within quarter
Security gating pass rate: 100% for mandatory controls (encryption, audit logs, RBAC) in staging
Beta customer latency SLOs met: 95th percentile token latency within target on Dedicated-equivalent topology
milestones: 2026-03-10: Draft slice definitions and owner assignments (slice A/B/C)
2026-03-24: Cross-team design review and compliance checklist signoff
2026-04-07: Engineering capacity commit and sprint plan for slice A
2026-04-21: Internal alpha deploy for slice A (select internal teams)
2026-05-01: Pilot invite opened for 2 customers and retrospective planning for next quarter
risks: Config compatibility: wide variance in customer on‑prem networking could delay onboarding
Security signoff delays: KMS/HSM vendor integration timelines are external and may block release
Resource contention: dedicated infra optimization work scheduled in same cycle (ENG-2483)
Feature creep: adding expanded observability features may push slice scope beyond timeline
cross_team_actions: Schedule weekly cadence with ENG infra, Security, and DX to unblock integration issues
Design to produce low-fidelity upgrade/rollback UX flows by 2026-03-18
Security to provide mandatory control checklist and test harness by 2026-03-24
Set up pilot environment templates (VPC peering, on-prem orchestrator) and publish runbook
notes: 2026-02-18 sync: PMs agreed to a 3-slice model (A: core deploy + RBAC, B: KMS+audit logs, C: observability+rollouts)
2026-02-22: Eng raised dependency on kernel scheduling improvements for latency targets (see ENG-2999)
Decision: defer advanced quantization features from this quarter to reduce scope (risk reduction)
Follow-up: coordinate with Sales on pilot candidate criteria and NDA checklist
stakeholders: Dr. Claire Ramos - Head of Security
Evan Walker - Eng Manager, Serving Runtime
